literature_notes: L1 (PMC12723151) describes a FLAG/His6/EGFP/TEV N-terminal fusion on ATP11C_cryst, which is explicitly a truncated construct used for structural studies; it does not meet the full-length membrane-anchored requirement and is disqualified. L2 (PMC13382312) describes full-length murine ATP11C bearing a 9-aa 1D4 epitope tag expressed in HEK293T cells; the 1D4 tag is a canonical C-terminal tag, and the C-terminus of ATP11C (residues 1091-1132) is intracellular per the authoritative topology landmarks — this is not a surface site. No ledger line supports a tag insertion on the extracellular face of full-length, membrane-anchored ATP11C. The five extracellular loops (86-94, 312-346, 898-908, 982-995, 1047-1060) are topologically accessible but no published insertion in any of them is recorded in the ledger.

literature_other_positions.note: Full-length murine ATP11C carries a C-terminal 1D4 (9-aa) epitope tag used for immunoprecipitation; the C-terminus (residue 1132) lies in the intracellular span (1091-1132) and is not a surface site.
